method: Hand-written single-best-answer MCQs grounded only in the accepted open full text.

topic.topicDisplayName: Synovial fluid analysis: WBC thresholds, crystals, viscosity, culture interpretation
topic.coverageNote: WBC thresholds, crystals, Gram stain, and culture are in SANJO. Viscosity is explicitly absent and is not invented.

mcqs.question: Which synovial white-cell thresholds does SANJO use?

options.A: Above 50,000/µL suggests infection but is not diagnostic; below 25,000/µL lowers probability but does not exclude it
options.E: Only the serum white-cell count is used

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Above 50,000/µL suggests infection but is not diagnostic; below 25,000/µL lowers probability but does not exclude it
mcqs.explanation: Greater than 50,000/µL is suggestive but not sufficient. Less than 25,000/µL decreases post-test probability but cannot exclude septic arthritis.

sourceRefs.excerpt: A synovial white blood cell count of > 50 000 cells µ L - 1 is suggestive of SANJO, but alone is not sufficient

mcqs.question: Can crystals and infection coexist in the way this guideline warns?

options.A: Yes. Gout and pseudogout may also raise the synovial white-cell count, so crystals do not exclude infection
options.E: A high white-cell count with crystals is always gout

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Yes. Gout and pseudogout may also raise the synovial white-cell count, so crystals do not exclude infection
mcqs.explanation: The guideline says gout and pseudogout may also increase white-cell counts, so a crystal diagnosis does not by itself settle the question of infection.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Gout and pseudogout may also increase levels of white blood cell coun

mcqs.question: What does the guideline say about Gram stain performance?

options.E: Sensitivity and specificity were not discussed

mcqs.explanation: Gram stain has limited sensitivity and excellent specificity.

sourceRefs.excerpt: Performing Gram staining on synovial fluid is recommended despite its limited sensitivity; given its excellent specificity

mcqs.question: Which culture practice is recommended?

options.A: Blood-culture bottles plus agar and thioglycolate broth, incubated 5–7 days
options.B: A single agar plate read at 12 hours
options.C: Culture of the needle hub only
options.E: No culture if crystals are seen

mcqs.correctAnswerText: Blood-culture bottles plus agar and thioglycolate broth, incubated 5–7 days
mcqs.explanation: Inoculate blood-culture bottles, plate sterile-tube fluid on agar and thioglycolate, and incubate 5–7 days according to local practice.

sourceRefs.excerpt: inoculate the remaining synovial fluid into blood culture bottles

mcqs.question: Does SANJO give a viscosity threshold?

options.A: No viscosity criterion is stated; the recommended analyses are culture, cell count, and crystals
options.B: Viscosity below a stated centipoise confirms infection
options.C: String sign length is the primary test

mcqs.correctAnswerText: No viscosity criterion is stated; the recommended analyses are culture, cell count, and crystals
mcqs.explanation: The guideline prioritizes bacterial identification, white-cell count, and crystals. It does not give a viscosity cut-off, so none is taught here.

sourceRefs.excerpt: white blood cell count including polymorphonuclear (PMN) percentage, and presence of crystals
